newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat despite bands change.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat despite bands change.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed largely flat at 475.75/476.75 per dollar after a Central Bank announcement of changes in its exchange rate bands system left markets unruffled, traders said.
"We were expecting the move," said one.
The Bank said that, as of January 2, the new central rate parity of 472 bolivars per dollar would depreciate by 1.32 percent a month with bands fixed 7.5 percent either side.

In July, the rate had been set at 470 per dollar with a monthly depreciation rate of 1.5 percent. Traders said the bolivar had maintained its strength on an expected two percentage point rise in TEM yields at Tuesday's auction.
